Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CUH Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the CUH recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Central University of Haryana recruitment is Senior Research Fellow. This is a contractual position with one vacancy available.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course. Crucially, they must have qualified through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or other national-level examinations conducted by central government departments, and have two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow position announced by the Central University of Haryana.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the CUH Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow post at Central University of Haryana is scheduled for 24th September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Central University of Haryana located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Haryana is located in Mahendergarh, Haryana, with the pincode 123031.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.
